title: Cow holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M70 40 Q68 52 60 58' stroke='#c8b8d8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='26' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='21' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ff9fb0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <polygon points='70,40 74,40 72,44' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <!-- cow body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='64' rx='22' ry='15' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='60' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#4a3f55'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#4a3f55'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='70' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#4a3f55'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='74' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <rect x='38' y='75' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <rect x='48' y='74' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <rect x='56' y='75' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <!-- hoofs -->
  <rect x='28' y='84' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#4a3f55'/>
  <rect x='38' y='85' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#4a3f55'/>
  <rect x='48' y='84' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#4a3f55'/>
  <rect x='56' y='85' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#4a3f55'/>
  <!-- cow head -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='52' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <!-- head spot -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='46' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#4a3f55'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='44' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f5f0e8' transform='rotate(-25 49 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='44' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff9fb0' transform='rotate(-25 49 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='75' cy='44' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f5f0e8' transform='rotate(25 75 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='75' cy='44' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff9fb0' transform='rotate(25 75 44)'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='39' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#e8d5a0' transform='rotate(-20 53 39)'/>
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='39' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#e8d5a0' transform='rotate(20 71 39)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='51' r='2.5' fill='#2e2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='51' r='2.5' fill='#2e2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='50' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='50' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='59' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='58.5' r='1.3' fill='#e07a8f'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='58.5' r='1.3' fill='#e07a8f'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M58 61.5 Q62 64 66 61.5' stroke='#b85a70' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- front arm holding string -->
  <path d='M58 62 Q64 60 70 58' stroke='#f5f0e8' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M20 62 Q14 64 12 70' stroke='#f5f0e8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='71' r='3' fill='#4a3f55'/>
</svg>
